title: Intro to Blender
line: Find your way around, model a mug, light it and render it.

project.title: A desk lamp, modeled and rendered
project.brief: Model a simple desk lamp on your own from a cylinder and a cone. Give it two materials, light it and save a render.
checks: At least two mesh objects, one with a Subdivision or Bevel modifier
A render is saved as an image

lessons.title: Move around the 3D viewport
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner the Blender viewport. Orbit, pan, zoom, the front, side and top views, and frame the selected object.
lessons.passes: The cube is framed in the front view.

lessons.title: Move, rotate and scale
lessons.goal: Teach G, R and S in Blender with axis keys and typed numbers by placing a cube, a cone and a sphere at set spots.
lessons.passes: The cube is at X 2, the cone is turned 90 degrees and the sphere is half size.

lessons.title: Edit mode: vertices, edges, faces
lessons.goal: Teach Blender Edit mode and the three select modes by pulling one edge of a cube up to make a wedge.
lessons.passes: One edge of the cube sits 1 m higher than the others.

lessons.title: Extrude and inset: the cup
lessons.goal: Teach Blender inset and extrude by hollowing a cylinder into the cup of a mug.
lessons.passes: The cylinder has a hollow with a wall and a floor.

lessons.title: Loop cuts and bevels
lessons.goal: Teach Blender loop cuts and bevel by adding two loops for the handle and beveling the rim of the mug.
lessons.passes: The mug has two new edge loops and a beveled rim.

lessons.title: Build the handle
lessons.goal: Teach extruding faces and bridging edge loops in Blender by growing a handle out of the side of the mug.
lessons.passes: The handle joins the mug in two places and the mesh is one piece.

lessons.title: Subdivision and smooth shading
lessons.goal: Teach Blender modifiers by adding Subdivision Surface at level 2 to the mug and turning on smooth shading.
lessons.passes: The mug has a Subdivision modifier at level 2 and smooth shading.

lessons.title: Give it a material
lessons.goal: Teach Blender materials with the Principled BSDF by giving the mug a glossy ceramic color.
lessons.passes: The mug has a material with roughness under 0.3.

lessons.title: Light it and aim the camera
lessons.goal: Teach Blender lights and the camera by adding an area light and framing the whole mug in the camera view.
lessons.passes: The scene has an area light and the camera sees the whole mug.

lessons.title: Render and save an image
lessons.goal: Teach rendering in Blender. Pick a render engine, set the size, render and save a PNG.
lessons.passes: A PNG render is saved next to the .blend file.
